question: Tinuod ba nga kailangan accredited sa BFP ang brand sa fire extinguisher o pwede ba mamaligya ang inspector sa bombero?
answer: Wala kaayong kailangan nga i-accredited ang brand sa fire extinguisher sa BFP. Ang BFP ay hindi pwedeng mag-recommend ng isang spesifik na brand ng fire extinguisher. Kung mayroon mga irregularidad, maaari kang mag-report sa mga contact numbers na nabigyan sa isang imahe sa BFP Citizens' Charter 2022 ([S2] at [S3]).

ground_truth: Under BFP Memorandum Circular No. 2016-016 and public anti-corruption warnings, the Bureau of Fire Protection does not accredit, endorse, or recommend any specific brand, store, or distributor of fire extinguishers or fire fighting equipment. BFP personnel are strictly prohibited from selling or recommending fire extinguishers. Portable fire extinguishers are regulated by the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) through the Bureau of Product Standards (BPS), and establishments may purchase any brand that complies with Philippine National Standards (PNS).
